rationale: E. lenta ferments lactate and glucose as primary C sources under anaerobic conditions, with arginine and ammonium as N sources. Mixed-acid fermentation yields acetate, formate, and CO₂ as major products. Uptake of 8 lactate + 6 glucose + 3 arginine + 2 ammonium + 1 cysteine supports growth at 0.25/h with fermentation products balancing the C budget.
